title: Walks that fail in the full sweep
goal: The scripted walks are the app driving itself, and some of them no longer reach what they were written to check. Find out what each failing walk is looking for, then either fix the app if the walk is right or update the walk if the app moved on.
notes:
Last sweep 2026-09-12T17:04:44Z: 348 of 357 walks passed in 68 minutes.

Failing walks (9): border-effect-walk, contents-for-several-walk, dock-picked-first-walk, glow-effect-walk, label-fills-a-row-walk, measure-row-menu-walk, menu-checkmarks-walk, open-groups-remembered-walk, readout-fields-walk

Full output: queue/sweep/2026-09-12-085710.log. Re-run one of them on its own with
Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/<name>.json --no-build, which takes about ten seconds.
Do NOT run Scripts/playtest-all.sh yourself; ask for a sweep with
queue/bin/sweep.sh request "<why>" and finish your task.

Sweep asked for by: panel-content-sits-twelve-points-from-each-edge: Every section header in the dock moved 2pt right (it was padded to 12 against the rows' 14), and the Appearance list lost three leading indents. Both are shared chrome that every walk photographs, so the whole set should confirm nothing else shifted.; corner-radius-folds-like-an-effect-with-its-chev: Corner Radius grew from a caption label to a 20pt heading row with a leading chevron, so every walk whose picture includes the Appearance section is a few points taller below that row; the scroll-sensitive walks are the ones worth the whole set.; an-effect-can-be-saved-as-a-named-style: Every effect in the Effects list grew a Style row at the top of its settings, which changes the height of every effect pane and adds a menu to every one of them. That touches every walk that opens a shadow, a glow, a border or a blur, and every walk that measures the dock's height budget.; a-text-style-can-be-dragged-off-the-shelf-onto-t: Added a text-style branch to the canvas drag destination (CanvasDrop draggingEntered/Updated/performDragOperation) and changed the dragTile step's shape, which 31 walks use. Five dragTile walks and both text-style walks pass; the whole set should confirm nothing else that drops on the canvas moved.; drag-a-shapes-corner-to-round-it: next-corner-handles changes press precedence on every picked shape: a press within 6 screen points of a dot 12 points inside a corner now starts a rounding drag instead of a layer move. The 17 corner/round/shape walks pass, but every walk that drags a selected shape near a corner is worth a look; picking-a-piece-of-text-brings-its-text-section: Picking a layer now scrolls the dock to that layer's own section (Text, Measurement, Zoom Callout, Arrow). Any walk that picks a layer and then presses a control in the right panel could now find that control in a different place. The dock, panel, text and callout families all pass locally; the rest of the set has not been run.; a-control-scrolled-out-of-its-own-section-gets-c: PlaytestPanelPress.fields() changed how every panel control gets its row names (a control scrolled out of its own list no longer picks up outer rows). Panel-heavy families (effects, parts, dock, section, layout, settings) are green locally, but this touches naming in every walk that uses in:.; an-arrow-s-parts-live-in-appearance-each-with-it: An arrow's parts moved into Appearance: the Appearance row list, the stroke row's name (Color -> Line), the arrow section going away, and AnnotationContent gaining four colours all touch shared code that many walks read; a-measurement-s-parts-live-in-appearance-like-ev: The Appearance row list changed for every measurement (Caliper, Chip, Chip Fill, Chip Edge, Chip Text replace the old Measurement section) and ColorSlot grew by four cases, so any walk that reads the panel or names a colour row could be affected. Ran measure, redline, caliper, part, appearance, colour and style walks by hand (37 walks, all pass).; holding-shift-while-dragging-a-caliper-end-keeps: The playtest drag step now carries an optional mid-drag key change ("halfway"), which every walk's drag goes through even when it does not use it; the measure family, caliper, redline, snap-hold and arrow-tip walks all pass, but the whole set is the honest check on a shared step.; a-border-can-be-offset-from-the-edge-it-sits-aga: Every Border row in the Effects panel gained an Offset row, and eleven walks had to be retargeted from Slider in Border to Slider in Border, Width. Any other walk that reaches a slider inside a border needs the same, and the panel is one row taller everywhere a border is open.; picking-a-mode-from-a-tool-s-flyout-picks-that-t: describe() now reports the crop aspect and rect in every walk's state line, and the tool bar buttons carry a new probe modifier, so every walk's log shape changed even though 23 measure/crop/tool walks pass; a-layer-can-change-what-is-underneath-it-blur-pi: The Lens tool adds one more button to the tool bar in Next (next-lens, on by default), which shifts every slot after it and every capture that includes the bar. Toolbar, narrow-window and panel-arms walks were run by hand and all pass, but the whole set should confirm nothing else measured off the bar.; a-layer-can-say-how-it-mixes-with-what-is-under: Added a Blending row to the shared Appearance section of the panel, which every walk that lists or measures that section sees. Ran panel, appearance and parts walks (26, all green) but the row shifts what is below it everywhere.; a-component-made-in-one-document-can-be-used-in: The Component section grew a row and the component drop path changed shape (an arriving drawing that is not in the document yet), so every walk that photographs the dock with a component selected or drags one off the shelf has a changed picture. 21 component and library walks pass; the rest of the set has not been run against it.; a-group-turns-like-anything-else: Group turning changed the selection chrome, the hit test, the rubber band and the compositor's group path, so a sweep is the honest check that nothing upright moved. Group, component, selection and angle walks all pass here (41 walks).; a-button-grows-when-a-style-makes-its-words-bigg: Starter Button and Badge now floor their height instead of fixing it (a text style that enlarges the label grows the pill). Ran ~95 walks around components, layout, padding, placement, styles, stacks and starters; the rest of the set has not seen the change.; decide-whether-a-style-can-be-set-on-one-copy-wi: Copy-owned text styles changed the component sync path (every copy is rebuilt through it) and the text style drop, so every walk that places a copy or drops a style is worth re-running; I ran the 25 copy and component walks and the 5 text-style walks by hand and all pass except two that fail the same way on clean main.; a-walk-names-a-panel-control-in-a-way-a-rename-c: Twenty scripted walks now name Appearance and Effects rows by a steady name instead of the words on them, and the harness matching that every walk's "in" goes through was changed to support it. The twenty were run and pass; the whole set should confirm nothing else moved.
